messages:
sara: Heads-up: deploybot failed during the 10:00 release push to us-east-1 ECR. Tag creation returned 409 and provenance attestation is missing. Pushing to prod is blocked.

deploy-bot: [automated] push failed for image redwood/service-api:2026.05.11-rc2 -> ECR us-east-1
```
ERROR: PutImage failed: TagAlreadyExistsException: image tag '2026.05.11-rc2' already exists with different digest
Missing attestation metadata: cosign.attestation.signature
```

chris: hmm could be a delayed mirror or previous partial publish. Which digest does the existing tag point to? can someone run `aws ecr describe-images`?

james: I pulled the manifest earlier, digest is sha256:abcd1234... but the CI build says sha256:ef12c345... mismatch.

sree: sounds like a race with a reconciler. Two options: 1) retag the CI-built image to a new unique tag and republish; 2) pin the deployment to the existing digest and skip repost. Both have tradeoffs for release notes and rollback.

infra-oncall: I'd prefer pin to digest for immediate rollout, then investigate mirror. Pinning is fast: update deploy config to `image: 123456789012.dkr.ecr.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/redwood/service-api@sha256:abcd1234` and promote.

sara: If we pin, we need to update release notes with the final digest and call out that the rc2 tag didn't carry provenance and will be reissued.

lex-release: +1 on pinning for today. We have a change window until 15:00. If republish required, schedule manual republish during off-peak.

james: If we republish, we must re-run cosign signing. Do we have the cosign key readily available in CI for manual push?

infra-oncall: yes, key in KMS; we can run a one-off job. But I'd rather avoid manual pushes unless necessary.

sree: Plan: 1) Pin release to existing digest and proceed canary. 2) Open infra ticket to reconcile the tag collision and re-publish a new tag with full provenance. 3) Add a line to release notes about transient tag collision and digest used. I'll open the PR for the deploy config and the release notes.

sara: OK let's do that. @deploy-bot schedule retry disabled and pin update applied. @lex-release please ack the release notes PR when ready :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: [automated] retry suppressed for thread 1761239999. Manual pin applied to deploy config by @sree.

lex-release: acked, will review the PR in 10.

james: leaving a note: rollback criteria unchanged — if canary fails we'll roll back to previous digest sha256:0000dead.

sree: filing infra ticket: INFRA-2028 "ecr tag shadowing during staged publish" with logs and suggested fix (quarantine duplicate tag test + stronger attest checks).

sara: thanks team. we'll proceed with canary and follow up after the infra ticket update. :rocket:
